Second independent check — is this M13 finding a REAL, actionable issue to fix before merge? Read the code; be skeptical; confirm only with a concrete pointer.
File:messages/en.json (nav.providers ("Listeners"))
Dead message key: nav.providers is now orphaned
components/shared/AppHeader.tsx previously had the admin nav point at { href: "/admin/providers", labelKey: "nav.providers" }, and that was the only consumer of nav.providers. This diff replaces it with labelKey "admin.navApprovals" and removes nav.providers from the labelKey union type. Grep confirms no remaining reference to nav.providers anywhere in the codebase, so the key is now dead.
